description: Two fists that engaged as pinches, separated by a frame with no hands (0.0-3.0 s, 3.5-6.5 s). The thumb tip rests against the curled index (pinch ratio 0.03-0.15), and with the fingers curled toward the camera the middle, ring and pinky look straight in the image (0.85-0.9), so these passed the OK-sign check. In 3D their tips are close to the wrist (reach 0.46-0.65; OK signs measure 1.7 or more). Neither should engage as a pinch. Recorded from a live webcam at 320x240 via HandwaveWidget.hands_data, every frame (~50 fps); labels are as the tracker sees them.
